title: FreeCell
desc: Clear all 52 cards to four foundations using eight cascades and four free cells, with undo, auto-move and full keyboard play.

title: Blackjack
desc: Beat the dealer to 21 with hit, stand and double against a dealer who stands on 17; naturals pay 3:2 and 2,000 chips wins the session.

title: Video Poker
desc: Draw five cards, hold the ones you keep, and chase the Jacks or Better paytable across eight game types until you double your stack.

title: Yahtzee
desc: Thirteen rounds of five dice: roll up to three times per round, hold the keepers, score every category, and reach 200 points to win.

title: Dominoes
desc: Play block dominoes against the computer: match the chain ends, draw from the boneyard when stuck, and be first to 100 points.
